description: A balding, stern general in Roman muscle armour and a red cloak stands on a large round shield held aloft by cheering legionaries, one hand raised and the other holding an eagle standard. Red banners, bronze standards, spears and tents fill a smoky dusk camp. A small plaque on the standard at right carries the word SIGNA. No frame or border; nothing graphic.
